title: Conducting Technical cum Commercial Feasibility Study for installation of Lift at Poompuhar, Kodikkarai, Nagapattinam, Mallipattinam and Kilakkarai Lighthouses.
summary: Two-cover e-tender for a technical-cum-commercial feasibility study for installing lifts at Poompuhar, Kodikkarai, Nagapattinam, Mallipattinam and Kilakkarai Lighthouses under the Chennai Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

scope.item: Conducting Technical cum Commercial Feasibility Study for installation of Lift
scope.site: Poompuhar, Kodikkarai, Nagapattinam, Mallipattinam and Kilakkarai Lighthouses

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. Tender fee NIL. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalised bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, payable at Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening.

period.completion: 60 days from the date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration, experience and expertise in similar works with State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, and valid CEIG registration certificate
Average annual financial turnover at least 40% of estimated cost

Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar work = technical cum commercial feasibility study for installation of elevators/lifts for multi-storeyed buildings/towers

OR reputed lift/elevator OEMs or their authorised agencies with experience installing lifts in multi-storeyed buildings/towers for government/autonomous bodies/PSUs: one work >= Rs 35.00 lakh, or two works each >= Rs 22.00 lakh, or three works each >= Rs 18.00 lakh
Only fully completed works with completion certificate; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
PAN/ITCC/GST registration; details of qualified technical personnel
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); affidavit/self-attestation of not being blacklisted; list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL
